 IN INTERNATIONAL WATERS
Members of an armed security team onboard a ship 
underway noticed a skiff approaching rapidly. Alarm raised, 
speed increased, crew mustered in a safe place and the 
armed team took their positions. At a distance of around 
600m meters there was an exchange of fire between the 
four pirates on the skiff and the armed team, resulting in the 
pirates aborting and moving away. All crew members are 
reported safe and unharmed.

on deck and alerted the bridge. The general alarm was 
sounded and all crew mustered. Upon detection, the 
perpetrators fled and jumped into a small boat. A thorough 
search was conducted.  The paint store lock was damaged 
and 10 cans of paint were stolen. The crew were not injured.
